name: General Qamar Javed Bajwa
real_life_parallel: Pakistan Army Chief 2016-2022; Balakot, Pulwama, Article 370 era

biography.background: Chief of Army Staff, Pakistan Army (2016-2022). Military counterpart to Indian leadership during surgical strikes (2016), Balakot (2019), Article 370 abrogation. Promoted 'Bajwa Doctrine' of de-escalation with India while maintaining terror proxy pressure.
biography.tenure_highlights: Balakot crisis management; Kartarpur corridor opening; post-Article 370 tensions
biography.extension_controversy: 3-year extension 2019; Imran Khan later claimed forced to grant it
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: Military adversary during strikes; institutional counterpart
